verdict.rationale: Rootly's escalation-policy docs say policies define what happens when an alert is not acknowledged in time. They also describe multi-step targets and time delays that keep escalating until on-call alerts get acknowledged. Separately, responders can acknowledge and escalate pages directly in Microsoft Teams. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repeat rounds (round robin is documented, but that is a different mechanism from repeating the policy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of escalation behavior.
